name: privacy
title: Privacy
description: Which app is using the camera, the microphone or the screen right now (a call, a screen share, a recording): a bar item that appears only while one is, and a palette of the same.
author: pal

store.tagline: See which app has your camera or microphone
features: A bar item that stays off the strip until the camera, the microphone or the screen is in use (a call, a screen share, a recording), then shows a glyph for each on an amber band
The app is named: the microphone per app, a helper or a command counted against the app that started it (`ffmpeg` in kitty reads kitty, with ffmpeg under it)
Named from the same source as the menu bar's dots (Control Center's own record), so a Zoom call reads zoom.us for the camera and a Meet share Google Chrome for the screen
Seen within a second of turning on or off, with no poll in the extension: the core watches and re-renders the item on a change
The popover lists every use; Enter brings the app forward, `s` opens the privacy settings
The palette lists the same rows, so `camera` or `mic` at the root answers who has it

actions.title: Show the app
actions.description: Brings the app using the sensor forward; a camera with no app opens its privacy settings.

screenshots.caption: One row per app: what it holds and for how long, a screen share and a recording in Terminal included
Enter brings the app forward; the privacy settings are a shortcut away
On the menu bar only while something is in use: a glyph for the camera, the microphone and the screen
A call sharing its screen: all three glyphs
A click opens the popover: one row per app, what it holds in colour and for how long; Enter brings the app forward
A screen share names its app too; macOS's own capture reads macOS
On sketchybar: the glyphs on an amber band

privacy.description: Every app using the camera, the microphone or the screen now, cameras first.

microphone.description: An app is recording from a microphone

screen.description: An app is sharing or recording the screen, or a Screen Sharing session is attached (macOS)

in-use.title: Camera, Mic & Screen
in-use.description: Off the strip until the camera, the microphone or the screen is in use, then a glyph for each on an amber band, the apps in the tooltip. The popover lists every use; Enter brings the app forward. Re-rendered within a second or two of a change.

keys.title: Move between the uses; a click on one focuses it

item.tooltip: Camera: MacBook Pro Camera · Microphone: zoom.us

empty.tooltip: Nothing is using the camera, the microphone or the screen

rules.when: not privacy.camera and not privacy.microphone and not privacy.screen
rules.description: Nothing in use: off the strip.
